initial_review: Read complete current/original diff and every affected entry;trace original converters/unthunkers,selected thunk dispatch and direct Post-to-Send path.
counter_review: Responsibilities are separate: invocation owns selector restoration;local converter record owns acquired resource release;post receiver owns successful DDE transfers. Removed duplicate selector authority without adding a shim. Failed-post unthunk and private retry do not consume the abandoned converted handles. TLS proof concerns pre-admission snapshot,not concurrent CCPU execution.
limits: Source scheduling proof,not reproduced native-thread race.
Focused source fixtures are not guest acceptance;Full remains required.
Original dialog entry negative controls are shared-converter evidence,not per-function fault reproduction for every wumsg entry.

points.evidence: wow_hook_callback.c snapshots fWhoCalled before wow_task_callback_enter. An admitted other native hook thread may snapshot another thread POST mode before waiting for execution,then restore it after the first thread reset. Original converter wmsg16.c reads this mode to choose new allocation versus borrowed alias. TLS isolates native-thread entry state;one worker CPU does not serialize pre-admission native snapshots. This is source-permitted ordering,not a newly reproduced race.
points.option: Remove redundant comment;retain TLS pending owner. No new per-task registry.

Caller-owned record cannot be released by outer thunk invocation because it is local to this function.
